claims.claim: Snowflake Q1 FY2027 product revenue reached $1.33B, up 34% year over year, and remaining performance obligations reached $9.21B, up 38%.
More than 13,600 accounts were using Snowflake AI capabilities; Snowflake Intelligence accounts more than doubled quarter over quarter and Cortex Code was used across more than 7,100 accounts.
Snowflake expanded its AWS relationship through a $6B multi-year agreement and signed an agreement to acquire Natoma to extend governance into AI-agent workflows.

factors.name: AI workload adoption
factors.basis: Broad account-level AI usage suggests AI is becoming a platform workload rather than only a narrative adjacency.

factors.name: contracted demand
factors.basis: RPO growth exceeded current product-revenue growth, supporting forward demand visibility.

factors.name: agentic governance expansion
factors.basis: Natoma and partner integrations extend Snowflake from data governance toward governed agent actions.

risks.risk: Usage metrics are company-defined and do not by themselves establish incremental AI revenue or durable unit economics.

unknowns.unknown: Incremental revenue directly attributable to first-party AI products is not separately disclosed in the cited release.

claims.claim: After Q1 FY2027 Snowflake raised full-year product-revenue guidance to $5.84B, representing 31% growth, and raised non-GAAP operating-margin guidance to 13.5%.
Q1 net revenue retention was 126%, with 779 customers above $1M trailing-12-month product revenue and 616 net new customers added in the quarter.

factors.name: growth execution
factors.basis: Product revenue, customer expansion and raised guidance support execution against growth expectations.

factors.name: operating leverage
factors.basis: Raised operating-margin guidance indicates management expects growth to convert into improved non-GAAP profitability.

risks.risk: Consumption-based demand can react quickly to customer optimization, macro pressure or competitive workload shifts.

unknowns.unknown: The investor page available to Scout currently exposes Q1 FY2027 as the latest FY2027 report; no later quarter is inferred.
